title: SidecarLocalTrace
description: The sidecar's internal on-device steps for one request, as an append-only event log. Protocol 1.0 delivers the whole log with the result; a future delivery mode may append to it incrementally, and a client that applies steps by `sequence` (last one wins) renders both identically. Contains no message content, so it can be shown even when the user declines to share the result.
